text:
sanjay: heads up — we're seeing a batch of PO/invoice ingest failures from the GCP marketplace connector. looks like a ledger schema fingerprint mismatch during attachment verify :grimacing:

maria: Ugh. Is this on staging only or prod?

sanjay: prod and staging. started around 09:12 UTC. affects ~30% of inbound POs for two partners (Orbitrix + NovaEdge). marketplace-bot logged the failing webhook: 

marketplace-bot: {
  "event": "invoice.ack_failed",
  "partner": "orbitrix",
  "error": "ledger_schema_fingerprint_mismatch",
  "payload": { "attachment_id": "att_9f3a", "signature_version": "v2" }
}

emma: do we know if it's a KMS/encryption change on their side? earlier this month we rolled out stricter fingerprint checks. could be a signing key rotation.

josh: quick check from infra — the verifier expects fingerprint format: `sha256:keyid:version`. their payloads show `sha256:BASE64SIG`. mismatch is causing our verifier to reject before parsing.

maria: can we temporarily relax the verifier to accept both formats? this is blocking billing ingestion and partner POs are stuck. finance is getting noisy. :angry: 

josh: we can add a permissive fallback for the next 4 hours, but need partner consent for parsing ambiguous signatures. fallback patch would be a 10-min deploy + tests.

sanjay: ok do that. @josh can you open a short-lived canary? tag me when live. I'll draft the partner note.

josh: will do. deploying permissive-verify branch to canary now. command: `deploy canary permissive-verify --tag=hotfix/ledger-fallback`

marketplace-bot: deploy started by josh at 2024-11-22T10:05:12Z — health checks pending

emma: legal/partner contract question: if we accept ambiguous signatures temporarily, any compliance exposure? @sara_legal can you weigh in?

sara_legal: brief: temporary acceptance is fine if we 1) log full payloads, 2) require partner to sign SLA addendum confirming key rotation, and 3) revoke fallback after 4 hours. I'll prep an email template.

maria: finance wants a status update for the AR desk. Sanjay, can you include ETA?

sanjay: ETA 30–45m for canary verification, then 90m to roll to prod if green. sending partner note now.

josh: canary healthy, hitting ~120 requests/min with permissive fallback. no errors in trace for sample batch.

marketplace-bot: alert suppressed — rate of failures down 92% (last 15m).

maria: awesome. can you also list the affected PO IDs so ops can prioritize reconciliation?

josh: pulling list, will paste in #support after this thread. sample IDs: PO-88231, PO-88247, PO-88260.

sanjay: partner reply (Orbitrix): "we rotated signing keys last week but missed updating the metadata in the marketplace. pushing fix to their metadata service now."

sara_legal: sending SLA addendum to partner legal, cc: finance + partnerships.

maria: thanks all — i'll keep AR and billing updated. next actions: (1) prod rollout if canary stays green, (2) revoke permissive fallback after partner confirms metadata update, (3) run a reconciliation job for affected POs.

sanjay: filing this as a deal-desk escalation for tracking. tagging @josh @sara_legal for postmortem blurb. closing thread once reconciliation completes. :white_check_mark:
